en.summary: The Goïta government approved a 2027 draft budget on 18 September with spending of CFAF 4,462.6bn (+11.75%). Revenue rises 14.6%, the deficit narrows to CFAF 596bn, and average growth of 6.5% is forecast for 2027-2029. The revised 2026 budget raised funds for national security.
en.leader: President Assimi Goïta (transitional, military) / Prime Minister Abdoulaye Maïga
agenda: More revenue (tax ratio 13.9% rising to 15.1% by 2029)

fr.summary: Le gouvernement Goïta a adopté le 18 septembre un projet de budget 2027 de 4 462,6 Md FCFA de dépenses (+11,75 %).
